newsitem.title: USA: HL&P 1,250 MW Texas nuke seen on line Fri.
newsitem.headline: HL&P 1,250 MW Texas nuke seen on line Fri.

text.p: Houston Lighting & Power Co's (HL&P) 1,250 megawatt South Texas nuclear power unit 2 was expected to resume electricity production Friday following a maintenance shutdown, a company spokesman said Monday.
The unit, in Palacios, Texas, had moved into a hot shutdown mode and should resume production Feb 28 following restart testing, said spokesman Alan Mikus.
South Texas 2 was shut Feb 8 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
Houston Lighting & Power is a subsidiary of Houston Industries Inc.
